reason: No feasible starting design was found among 35 valid CAD/FEA geometries in the 40-point coarse feasibility study.
The closest sampled candidate failed the 0.75 mm tension stress requirement.
The validation-selected Phase 3 MLP has only three held-out geometry groups and held-out stress MAE 208.855 MPa, RMSE 291.950 MPa and R2 0.031; its metadata is EXPLORATORY_SCREENING_ONLY.
conclusion: No optimized candidate, no accepted weight reduction, and no proof that the full bounded domain is infeasible.
